question: In a certain code language, BONES is written as GLSVX, and CLOCK is written as HQLHP. How will PHOTO be coded in that language?
solution: **The logic followed here is:** Vowels – reverse letter in the alphabet Consonants – (+5) in the positional value of the consonants [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aefcd090e4721ab168474cd72dc7f0a88835716ce3c569f68482016e79ea81ae.png] BONES is written as GLSVX,
